text:
pranav: Quick async sync — kernel/batching/kv. Please drop a 1-2 line status + blockers. Owners: kernel=Mika, batching=Anya, kv=Michael. Need canary schedule by EOD today.

anya: batching: canary started on staging at 10:30, saw ~8% tail improvement (p95->p95.5) for seq<=512. PRs: #4123 (batch controller) — needs review from @jen. Blocker: long-running requests still cause head-of-line delays, working on a throttling knob.

mika: kernel: landed small scheduling change. Observed regression in microbatch throughput for seq_len=2048 after cache tweak. Suspect prefetch ordering bug in kernel. Investigating now; if no fix by EOD I'll roll back the change.

michael: kv-cache: warmup landed in test env. Still seeing cold-starts on new pods — TTL not aggressive enough. Tuning patch in PR #4135. Also need infra to bump initial canary replicas for stability. cc @kai.

jen: I can review #4123 tonight, will do a quick pass and flag anything risky.

kai: infra: can bump staging canary replicas 2->4; will schedule after approval, ETA ~30m. Noted noisy neighbors on r3-spot nodes; might affect tail latency.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for batch-controller v1.9.3 at 2026-03-17 15:12 UTC. Monitor: https://deploys/reports/3999991111

anya: quick question — do we have an automated SLO threshold for canary rollback? want to ensure we don't manually watch if it spikes.

pranav: yes — we have a canary policy: latency regression >15% for 5m triggers automatic rollback. I'll paste the policy into #eng-sre. If infra changes happen, please ping here once complete.

mika: +1 on a rollback plan; will revert kernel tweak if perf doesn't stabilize by 18:00 UTC.

michael: merging #4135 once tests finish; will also open infra request to bump replicas.

jen: reviewed #4123, left 2 tiny comments (naming + one test). Will re-approve after fix.

pranav: Next steps: @anya follow up on throttling config PR, @mika continue kernel investigation / prepare rollback, @michael merge kv fix + request infra change, @kai perform replica bump. I'll re-run canary watch at 17:30 UTC — please ping here when done :thumbsup:

mika: pinged on the investigation channel with traces; added perf diff to the PR.

anya: will post throttling config snippet later today and link patch.

kai: replica bump scheduled, starting now. Will update once nodes stabilized.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary health check reports 2/4 failed checks (tail latency). Auto-roll disabled because manual window active.

pranav: thanks — leaving this thread open for updates. If anything needs an immediate decision, call me.
